acceptance: The exporter writes one review CSV per tab with one wide row per record, joins a record's field proposals, lists a record once across proposals and folders, omits records that already match the export, and orders rows by what they need from the lead. (B01, B02, B03, B04, B10)
A refresh preserves the lead's review columns, and a base value that differs from the export gives a flagged conflict with nothing overwritten. (B05, B06)
The same inputs give identical files, an invalid input or secret-like value stops with an error naming it and writes nothing, and no input or tracker is changed. (B07, B08, B09)
